description:
Cast Vaultborn Tyrant by paying {5}{G}{G}.
When Vaultborn Tyrant enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to gain 3 life and draw a card.
Trudge Garden triggers. Choose not to pay.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Vaultborn Tyrant, adding {C}{C}.
When Vaultborn Tyrant dies, its second ability triggers, creating a token copy of it that is an artifact in addition to its other types.
When the Vaultborn Tyrant token enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to gain 3 life and draw a card.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters the battlefield, the Vaultborn Tyrant token's first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Vaultborn Tyrant trigger, causing you to gain 3 life and draw a card.
Repeat from step 7.
